response.rationale: The item is defective (screen went black on day 3 and won't turn on, confirmed by testing multiple cables and another laptop) and is not a final-sale item. RET-020 (priority 90) applies and dominates the out-of-window electronics/standard rules (RET-003, RET-008), allowing return regardless of the standard window. Final-sale (RET-012) does not apply since final_sale is false, and no fraud hold is present.
